opportunity: A load that reads bytes a later store overwrites could print after that store: one base plus two different constant offsets counted as two objects whatever the access widths, so `mov eax,[rdi+7]; mov [rdi+8],sil` printed `*(char *)(a0 + 8) = a1; return *(unsigned int *)(a0 + 7);`, which returns the new byte. A typed read split into per-field reads (SplitDatatype::split_load) was built at its lone COPY, after any store or call in between, so on a DWARF build `mov eax,[rdi+7]; mov [rdi+9],sil` printed `s->c9 = (char)w;` before the field reads
test_name: tests/stages/kuna-aliasoverlap.xml (8 assertions; #1-#3 and #5-#7 fail on main) + kuna-cli/tests/decompile_all_cli.rs a_load_is_not_printed_after_a_store_into_its_bytes (round trip of six printed functions; main 3/6 wrong, fix 0/6) + a_split_load_is_not_moved_past_a_store_or_a_call (DWARF round trip of four printed functions; main 3/4 wrong, fix 0/4)
binary: decompiler/crates/kuna-analysis/tests/fixtures/aliasoverlap_x86_64 (gcc -O2 from aliasoverlap_x86_64.c; clang -O2 emits the same instruction pairs); decompiler/crates/kuna-analysis/tests/fixtures/splitload_x86_64 (gcc -O2 -g from splitload_x86_64.c)
change_kind: strict correctness fix (no option: it only stops a load from printing after a store that overwrites some of its bytes)
inspiration: Ghidra ActionMarkImplied::isPossibleAlias / isPossibleAliasStep (coreaction.cc); upstream master f9e13846 has the same hole and a FIXME on its constant arm; Ghidra SplitDatatype::splitLoad (subflow.cc, insertPoint = copyOp when the LOAD's lone use is a COPY)
root_cause: ActionMarkImplied::checkImpliedCover forces a LOAD explicit when its cover crosses a STORE whose pointer isPossibleAlias says may equal the load's. isPossibleAlias compares pointer VALUES only: a pointer plus any constant (isPossibleAliasStep), one base plus two different constants (INT_ADD arm: !functionalEquality(bases)), and two different constant addresses all answer 'different', whatever the access widths, so a 4-byte load at base+7 was judged independent of a 1-byte store at base+8. Separately, SplitDatatype::splitLoad re-creates the per-field LOADs at the LOAD's lone COPY whatever lies between the two, so a STORE into the read bytes or a call between them ended up before the reads.
fix: p6_variables/coreaction_cleanup.rs: check_implied_cover passes the store's value size and the load's output size (AliasSpan {w1, w2, scale}); a constant step, two distinct constants off functionally equal bases, or two constant addresses answer 'different' only when [o1,o1+w1) and [o2,o2+w2) are disjoint (distance taken signed at the pointer size). A distance between two PTRADD indices is scaled by the element size; a negation reverses it; an XOR by a constant is at least its lowest set bit away in either direction. Commuted matches are only taken for byte-scaled adds. The predicate answers 'may alias' everywhere main's did, so the fix can only turn implied loads explicit. p3_dataflow/subflow.rs: split_load declines the split when store_or_call_between finds a STORE or a call between the LOAD and its lone COPY, or the two in different blocks; the read then prints whole ahead of the store or call. Splitting at the LOAD and keeping the COPY was tried first and rejected: on tar O0 validate_uparams (DWARF) the COPYs write the global uparams at the return, and four of five stores stopped printing.
